review: DAENEM Staff Portal workforce Attendance and Payroll company-boundary review

findings.summary: Attendance and Payroll permission checks could reuse authority granted for one assigned company when operating on another assigned company.
findings.correction: Attendance view/clock and every Payroll authority decision now evaluate the requested company explicitly against backend permission truth.

findings.summary: Payroll adjustments could reference an employee outside the target company and approval authority was not evaluated for that company.
findings.correction: Adjustment creation now requires an active target-company membership and target-company approval authority.

findings.summary: Unauthorized Payroll detail and status routes disclosed whether a run identifier existed.
findings.correction: Unauthorized run reads and status changes now return the same neutral not-found response as a missing record.

findings.summary: Attendance location joins and photo objects did not repeat company scope.
findings.correction: Location joins, object keys, and R2 metadata now bind attendance evidence to the authoritative company.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Attendance and Payroll company-isolation, neutral-denial, and evidence-scope change; broader Staff profile/self-service and authenticated V45 browser acceptance remain pending.
